title: One request passes through R0 to R13 in order; R14 to R20 run beside every request or between releases
aria: The request path across the blocks: R0 front door, R1 edge and controller, R2 admission and input guardrails, R3 cache check, R4 router, R5 context assembly, R6 gateway call, R7 settle and meter, R8 classify the reply, R9 agent or workflow loop, R10 per-call policy, R11 human in the loop, R12 output handling, R13 response and memory write-back. Cross-cutting: R14 tracing, R15 online evals, R16 drift detection, R17 feedback and triage. Between releases: R18 offline eval gate, R19 staged rollout, R20 governance.

route.title: R0 · Front door
route.text: The request arrives through one of the front doors (the app's screens over REST, the in-app assistant, or an outside assistant over MCP); each door authenticates and builds its own context, and all of them reach the same tool layer and services.

route.title: R1 · Edge and controller
route.text: Authenticate; resolve tenant and entitlements and carry them downstream; the request carries the client-held history.

route.title: R2 · Admission and input guardrails
route.text: Spend cap at the activity door; PII redaction, injection or moderation classifier, topical scope; may short-circuit to a canned reply.

route.title: R3 · Cache check
route.text: Exact or semantic response cache, scoped per tenant; a hit returns at once.

route.title: R4 · Router
route.text: A cheap classifier picks the workflow and the model tier.

route.title: R5 · Context assembly
route.text: System prompt from the registry with its version; trimmed history; memory facts; retrieved passages; tool definitions; stable layers first for the prompt cache; inside the token budget.

route.title: R6 · Gateway call
route.text: Usage context check, candidate list, provider attempt with retries inside the time budget, fallback; structured output or strict tool schemas.

route.title: R7 · Settle and meter every attempt
route.text: Ledger rows priced at write time, allowance debit, cached-input row.

route.title: R8 · Classify the reply
route.text: Finish reason to stop reason; text, tool calls, refused or malformed.

route.title: R9 · Agent or workflow loop
route.text: Run the tool calls, feed results back, call the model again; stop at a step, cost or time budget.

route.title: R10 · Per-call policy before a tool runs
route.text: Validate arguments, scope to the caller's tenant, refuse unknown tools; model-written code goes to the sandbox.

route.title: R11 · Human in the loop
route.text: A risky write becomes a sealed card, the turn pauses, the person approves, rejects or changes, the turn resumes.

route.title: R12 · Output handling
route.text: Schema and business validation, output guardrails, escape before rendering, never auto-load URLs.

route.title: R13 · Response and memory write-back
route.text: Facts proposed in the reply, queued in the same transaction, stored by a worker.
